label: Qualifying
insights: Kimi Antonelli took pole with 1:34.035, 0.179 s clear of VER.
Q1 cut-off (top 16): ALO went through by 0.291 s; OCO missed out by 0.291 s.
Q2 cut-off (top 10): LAW went through by 0.022 s; GAS missed out by 0.022 s.
Track evolution: the same drivers found 0.575 s from Q1 to Q2 and 0.015 s from Q2 to Q3 (median).
Fastest sectors: S1 RUS, S2 ANT, S3 ANT; together a 1:33.843 lap.
Most time left on the table: SAI, 0.366 s slower than their own best sectors added up.
Biggest teammate gap: COL 0.642 s behind their teammate (Alpine).

text: Front Corner Performance - Flow Conditioning Revised Front Corner and Furniture The front corner scoop and furniture have been revised in conjunction with the front suspension fairings aiming at improved flow conditioning.
Rear Corner Performance - Flow Conditioning Updated Rear Corner Furniture The rear corner furniture has been revised to achieve an improvement in flow conditioning as well as increased local load.
Diffuser Performance - Flow Conditioning New diffuser geometry The diffuser geometry has been modified aiming at an improvement of flow conditioning and local load across the speed range.

Front Wing Performance - Local Load Additional vane on the endplate foot plate Taking the recently introduced front wing geometry, an option to operate with the tyre temperature turning vane has been added for evaluation, offering a tyre surface temperature measurement as well as more local load with similar flow stability.

Front Corner Reliability Elastomeric gaitor profile revision The periphery of the gaitor has been revised to reduce the likelihood of tearing the elastomeric material during running by reducing the strain in the regions of highest deflection when steering lock is applied.

Floor Body Performance – Local Load and Flow Conditioning Updated board brace layout, redesigned front floor leading edge reshaping of both inboard vertical and top horizontal board elements Key development features have focused on increasing floor downforce (on both front and rear parts) whilst also increasing energy levels  and flow stability sent towards the back of the car
Floor Board
Sidepod Inlet / Coke Sidepod inlet additional lower volume, reshaped undercut and coke line volumes

Diffuser Revised diffuser volume, expansion profile, fence loading and trailing edge outboard furniture Benefitting from  improved onset flow quality, the diffuser expansion and  overall geometry has been further optimized , and returns increased aerodynamic load in an efficient way

Front Wing Performance - Flow Conditioning New front wing endplate The front wing endplate plays an important role in managing the flow around the front tyres. These updates further improve the management of the flow field downstream.
Rear Wing Performance - Local Load New flap elements The camber and chord of the rear wing flap elements has been modified to clean up the local flow and allow the wing to generate more load.

Floor Body Performance - Local Load Multiple changes including leading edge devices, board and floor edge A combination of developments across a number of key floor components which improves the overall flow management around the floor. This translates into an efficient downforce increase.

Coke/Engine Cover Performance - Flow Conditioning Reprofiled shoulder and undercut Working in combination with the updates made to the floor, the changes to the engine cover help manage the flow as it passes around the side of the car and towards the rear.

Front Corner Performance - Flow conditioning  New front brake duct The revised front brake duct provides updated cooling characteristics together with associated aerodynamic performance, complementing the latest development steps introduced.

Front Floor Performance - Flow conditioning  New Floor Board The updated floorboard geometry is intended to improve local flow conditioning and support the overall aerodynamic performance of the floor assembly.

Mirror stay Performance - Flow conditioning  New Mirror Stay The updated mirror stay geometry complements the revised front corner configuration and supports the overall aerodynamic performance of the car package introduced lately.

Floor Corner Performance - Local Load Redesigned rear floor corner The rear floor corner has been redesigned to improve the local flowfield interaction with the rear corner while also increasing local load.
Rear Wing Performance - Local Load Reprofiled rear wing flap The second and third element flap of the rear wing have been redesigned to improve rear wing flow quality and overall load delivery.

Floor Fences Performance – Flow Conditioning Updated Forward Floor Fence Geometry Revised geometry improves flow conditioning to the rear of the car and reduces sensitivity to changes in car attitude, whilst retaining overall aerodynamic load

Cooling Louvres Performance – Cooling Range Updated Sidepod Top Deck Cooling Louvres The sidepod top deck louvres have been updated to increase the power unit cooling capacity, whilst minimising the effect on aerodynamic performance
